biotools.summary: 'ggtreeExtra' extends the method for mapping and visualizing associated data on phylogenetic tree using 'ggtree'. These associated data can be presented on the external panels to circular layout, fan layout, or other rectangular layout tree built by 'ggtree' with the grammar of 'ggplot2'.
